### Auna Announces Reporting Dates for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


10/13/2026


LUXEMBOURG--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**Auna S.A. (NYSE: AUNA)** (“Auna” or “the Company”), a leading Latin American healthcare services and plan provider with operations in Mexico, Peru and Colombia, announced today the reporting dates for its Third Quarter 2026 financial results.


**Earnings Release**


Tuesday, November 17, 2026


Time: After Market Close


**Conference Call**


Wednesday, November 18, 2026


Time: 8:00 a.m. ET


**Quiet Period**


Monday, November 2 through Tuesday November 17, 2026


**To participate, please dial**


+1 833-461-5787 (Toll-Free)


+1 585-542-9983 (International)


Entry Passcode: 489 711 788


Webcast:[click here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F489711788&esheet=54619117&newsitemid=20261009707378&lan=en-US&anchor=click+here&index=1&md5=3d69c1c486ce4f2b5be3122ffa5d6316)


**About Auna**


Auna is a leading horizontally and vertically integrated healthcare platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, focusing on high-complexity diseases. Our mission is to transform healthcare by providing access to a highly integrated healthcare offering in the underpenetrated markets of Spanish-speaking Americas. Founded in 1989, Auna has built one of Latin America′s largest modern healthcare platforms that consists of a horizontally integrated network of healthcare facilities and a vertically integrated portfolio of oncological plans and selected general healthcare plans. As of June 30, 2026, Auna’s network included 31 healthcare network facilities, including hospitals, outpatient, prevention and wellness facilities with 2,337 beds, and 1.5 million healthcare plans. For more information visit[www.aunainvestors.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aunainvestors.com&esheet=54619117&newsitemid=20261009707378&lan=en-US&anchor=www.aunainvestors.com&index=2&md5=80a9af975c4c12e7070d949589713e3e)
